documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting 30Th October 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust demand in the commercial vehicles and trailer segments. Management highlighted capacity expansion initiatives, including the commercial production of extruded axle beams and ongoing progress on the seamless tube facility. While rising consumable and commodity costs have put some pressure on margins, price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support performance in the upcoming quarters. The company remains optimistic about end-market demand and is focused on improving capacity utilization and operational efficiency. Kross Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV, trailer, and tractor segments, alongside contributions from new capacity expansions.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2, with historically H2 being 20% higher than H1.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2. Overall volumes and historically also H2 is always 20% up on H1.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports this year to be 45% higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: With healthy order books, sustained demand in the trailer and tractor segments, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion, Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company targets an export contribution of 8% of total business in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

guidance.claim: Management is looking for a growth of 40% to 45% in exports for the financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent and is expected to continue into Q3 supported by lower tractor inventory levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent. We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Indications suggest that Q3 and Q4 should be even better for the commercial vehicle business.
demand_outlook.quote: And indications do suggest that the next 2 quarters, that is quarter 3 and quarter 4 should be even better.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum continued in the M&HCV segment with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 trailer volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agri segment demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum in the tractor and agri segment is expected to continue into Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Momentum expected to continue into Q3; contribution of this segment set to rise over the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor segment is performing very well, and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment are performing better than expected.
demand_outlook.quote: The trailer segment -- sorry, the tractor segment is doing very well and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment is doing better than expected.

demand_outlook.claim: OEMs have provided indications for a strong September quarter followed by subsequent quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging with consistent demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the Tractor segment, demand has been consistent, on track to increase contribution meaningfully over the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The CV business is expected to grow well in terms of volumes with good projections indicated from September onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: So Mihir, the CV business is supposed to grow well in terms of volumes this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company envisages expansion through an increase in axle shaft production, forward integration into cold drawn tubes, and enhanced investment in robotic automation.
capex_expansion.quote: The company further envisages expansion through strategic increase in axle shaft production, forward integration into manufacturing by making Cold Drawn Tubes and enhanced investment in robotic automation for forging operations as well as machining facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced, with current axle beam capacity at 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced • Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: Seamless tube facility mills are installed with production trials targeted for February-March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Seamless tube facility: mills installed, production trials targeted for February–March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Forging capacity expansion initiatives are on track to support higher volumes and improved cost competitiveness.
capex_expansion.quote: Forging capacity Expansion initiatives on track to support higher volumes and improved cost competitiveness.

capex_expansion.claim: High-pressure moulding line foundry is progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: High-pressure moulding line (Foundry) Progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle beam extrusion line has started production and is now in operation.
capex_expansion.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility remains on track with the piercing mill received and other mills on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, which will double foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: During Q2 FY27, EBITDA margins stood at 13%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR 30.6 crores and EBITDA margins of 13%, while profit after tax stood at INR (197) million, reflecting to a year-on-year change of 143%.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support the company during Q3 and Q4 amidst rising consumable and commodity costs.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced and current capacity utilisation is approximately 60-65%.
margins_costs.quote: Axle beam extrusion plant: Commercial production has commenced; current utilisation approximately 60–65%.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration through the seamless tube facility is expected to reduce external dependency and lower production costs.
margins_costs.quote: Enhances backward integration, reduces external dependency, and lowers production costs.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 EBITDA grew 39.5% year-on-year with margins expanding to 12.23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

margins_costs.claim: A recent steel price settlement retrospective to suppliers was given around July 15th.
margins_costs.quote: One is with the commodity price increase, that is steel for us. So steel, there has been a very recent settlement which has been given retrospective to all the suppliers. This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

margins_costs.claim: Prices in the trailer business were increased with effect from April 1st.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have increased our prices on our trailer business with effect from 1st of April itself, right.

margins_costs.claim: The price hike taken in the trailer axles business is approximately between 3% to 5%.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2, the company produced in excess of 10,500 trailer axles.
orders_capacity.quote: For quarter 2, we've done roughly -- we've done in excess of 10,500 trailer axles.

orders_capacity.claim: For the half year, total trailer axle volumes crossed 20,000 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: And if you look into our half yearly, we have almost crossed 20,000 numbers.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for tipping jacks is 800 kits per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 226 tipping jacks in Q1 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Total axle volume reached approximately 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes reached around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers in Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: The company undertook a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores to focus on capacity expansion and gearing up for coming years.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total budgeted cost for the seamless tube facility is approximately INR170 crores, funded by INR110 crores via term loan and the rest from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, we -- the total budgeted cost is approximately INR170 crores, okay? Out of this is funded by INR110 crores via term loan. The rest is from internal accruals, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: The seamless tube facility project is funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Funded through a mix of debt & internal accruals

capital_allocation.claim: IPO funds have been fully utilized as per plan for capacity expansion and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan. This has been achieved and the funds deployed towards capacity expansion and working capital have been as per plan.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

risks_headwinds.claim: The months of June and July typically see subdued demand due to monsoon conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are planned in February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: By Q3 or Q4, trailer axles will be produced exclusively through the extruded beam process.
management_commitments.quote: This particular aspect of business by Q3 or Q4, we will be producing our trailer axles in this methodology only by the extruded beam process.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase its export contribution to approximately 8% in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

management_commitments.claim: The axle shaft production facility is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to do production trials for the seamless tube facility by the end of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think by end of this financial year, we should be doing some production trials.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
